items.title: OpenAI abandons plan to release upcoming model as safety concerns escalate
items.description: The heads of OpenAI and rival Anthropic have both indicated recently that top AI labs should slow the pace of model development.

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Spectacle-heavy Trump-Xi summit was more about domestic messaging
items.description: Much of the pageantry was meant for the leaders' constituencies at home, analysts said.

items.title: LeBron James is already boosting ticket and merchandise demand for Philadelphia 76ers
items.description: NBA star LeBron James is having a major financial impact on the Philadelphia 76ers and Philadelphia, boosting sponsorships, ticket sales and economic activity

items.title: AMD briefly joined the $1 trillion club. Cramer says its monster run isn’t over
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said AMD’s run isn’t over, arguing the rise of agentic AI will drive significant demand for the company’s high-end CPUs.

items.title: Feds can't withhold counterterrorism funds from states to force election admin changes, judge rules
items.description: The judge said FEMA never explained how the election changes it wanted were "tied to the goal of shoring up vulnerabilities to terrorist attacks."

items.title: Khanna to introduce AI safety bill with ban on 'recursive' technology until safeguards exist
items.description: The proposal joins a chorus of other measures being put forward in Congress as the body mulls how to regulate AI.

items.title: Trump announces plan for $15 billion steel plant, would be largest in U.S. history
items.description: Trump's announcement with Mesabi Metallics comes as Americans' souring views of the economy are poised to shape the upcoming midterm election.

items.title: Elon Musk, SpaceXAI subpoenaed by NYC in AI safety investigation
items.description: The New York City Council issued a subpoena to Musk, requiring that he or another representative of SpaceXAI testify in an investigation concerning AI safety.

items.title: Meta, Google, Amazon, Microsoft draw Sen. Warren questions about AI tax subsidies
items.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren is asking the leaders of Meta, Google, Amazon and Microsoft about AI and data center subsidies authorized by GOP legislation.

items.title: Michael Burry believes the AI bubble 'may burst' sooner than he first believed
items.description: The famed short seller is switching to puts with expiries in June for his major tech short bets.

items.title: OpenAI sparked Hugging Face bids with early investment offer ahead of Nvidia's $13 billion deal
items.description: Hugging Face saw a flurry of deal interest before Nvidia agreed to buy the open-source platform for roughly $13 billion, CNBC has learned.

items.title: Treasury yields rise as march to multiyear highs continues
items.description: Treasury yields edged higher on Monday as investors look ahead to fresh economic data releases this week.

items.title: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead enterprise unit. MongoDB shares crater
items.description: Desai will lead the new Meta Enterprise Platform unit and report to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

items.title: Boeing 737 Max 10 certification delayed by software issue, FAA says
items.description: The FAA administrator said the Max 10 will be delayed until the agency can assess a software issue on the aircraft.

items.title: Supreme Court Justice Alito will not participate in big climate change case next week
items.description: Environmental groups had called for Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito to recuse himself from the case involving ExxonMobil and Suncor Energy.

items.title: Senate tees up college sports bill aimed at regulating NIL deals
items.description: The Senate is due to vote Monday on the bill, which would create a national framework for name, image and likeness deals in college athletics.

items.title: Meta's splashy new business AI hire offers yet another reason to bank on Zuckerberg
items.description: By poaching MongoDB's CJ Desai, Mark Zuckerberg shows he's serious about building an enterprise AI business.

items.title: IRS hires Joseph Velli to help administer Trump accounts
items.description: Velli previously served on the boards of Paychex, Cognizant and Computershare.

items.title: Oil prices off highs after reports Saudi pipeline ramping back up
items.description: The Saudis shutdown the pipeline earlier this month after it sustained damage in a drone strike launched form Iraq.

items.title: Anthropic launches cheaper AI model, its second release since CEO's call for a slowdown
items.description: The company said Sonnet 5.5 doesn't advance the frontier, but that it is better at coding and knowledge work tasks than its predecessor.
